messages.author: a1ded94aa0e83e13
messages.subject: Latex cyrillic
parts:
My app generates reports which contain Cyrillic symbols by knit2pdf.
It works great on my local computer, but fails at shinyapps.io with such message:
Running 'texi2dvi' on 'report_ru.tex' failed.
LaTeX errors:
! Package fontenc Error: Encoding file `t2aenc.def' not found.
(fontenc)                You might have misspelt the name of the encoding.

I use such code to produce Cyrillic symbols:
\usepackage[T2A]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[english,russian]{babel}

How to enable Cyrillic symbols at shinyapps.io?
Maybe with xelatex but which fonts shinyapps.io has?

Thanks!

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Latex cyrillic
parts:
I think the package texlive-lang-cyrillic is missing on ShinyApps.io.
We will see what our system admins can do.

Regards,
